shipped_rows.title_o: Variety-Seeking and Time of Day: Why Leader Brands Hope Young Adults Shop in the Afternoon, but Follower Brands Hope for Morning

blind_target.authors: Gullo, K., Berger, J., Etkin, J., & Bollinger, B.
blind_target.title: Does time of day affect variety-seeking?
blind_target.outcome_quote: Similar to Gullo et al. (2019), we found variety-seeking increases from the morning to the afternoon. Additionally, we found a post-lunch dip. Our results as such lend further support to the matching mechanism between variety-seeking and diurnal level proposed by Gullo et al. (2019) rather than the compensating mechanism suggested by Roehm and Roehm (2004).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The new UK sample confirms the increasing pattern reported by Gullo and contradicts the decreasing pattern reported by Roehm; the authors explicitly favor the matching mechanism.
